title.zh: 创建VPC防火墙资产同步任务

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于创建VPC边界防火墙。该VPC边界防火墙是防护通过高速通道连接的两个VPC之间的流量。该VPC边界防火墙不支持防护VPC跨地域、跨账号以及VPC与VBR间的互访流量。更多信息，请参见[VPC边界防火墙限制说明](~~172295~~)。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation creates a VPC firewall that protects traffic between two VPCs connected by an Express Connect circuit. The VPC firewall does not protect cross-region traffic, cross-account traffic, or traffic between a VPC and a Virtual Border Router (VBR). For more information, see [Limits on VPC firewalls](~~172295~~).

### QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10 calls per second. If you exceed this limit, your API calls will be throttled. Plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw create-vpc-firewall-task --lang zh --task-action sync --priority 1 --content test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw CreateVpcFirewallTask --region cn-hangzhou --TaskAction sync --Priority 1 --Content test --Lang zh
